stem.text: Heating compound X, $\text{C}_7\text{H}_{14}\text{O}_2$, under reflux with an excess of acidified potassium dichromate(VI) produces compound Y.
Compound Y produces hydrogen gas with sodium metal and forms orange crystals with 2,4-DNPH reagent.

A.alt: Skeletal formula of a cyclohexane ring with a CH2OH group and an OH group on opposite carbons.

B.alt: Skeletal formula of a cyclohexane ring with two OH groups on opposite carbons and a CH3 group on a carbon next to one of them.

C.alt: Skeletal formula of a cyclopentane ring: one carbon bears both a CH3 group and an OH group, and a CH2OH group is on a ring carbon two positions away (1,3 relationship).
